title: Can playing video games get you a better job
titleChinese: 玩电游能找到好工作吗？
paragraphs: Do you enjoy playing computer games? They can be thrilling, especially when you’re competing against others. They involve lots of skill, and offer a chance to switch off from the pressures of real life. But imagine if your gaming talents could actually be put to use in the real world? Well, now businesses are waking up to the skills gamers can bring to the workplace.

As an example, the BBC spoke to trainee surgeon Saied Froghi. He played video games like Age of Empires and Halo in his spare time when he was at medical school. But this relaxing pastime wasn’t distracting him from his studies - he thinks his time in front of a screen actually helped his surgery skills. He claims it helped him with his concentration, and he compares some of the skills used in keyhole surgery with using a games console. He says “Your hands know where the buttons are and how to rotate the instrument.”

Certainly, operating gaming controls help to develop good hand-eye coordination, but there are other abilities you can learn which can be applied to real-life work situations. Start-up company Game Academy told the BBC’s David Molloy that some games involve strategy and resource management, which are good skills for management. It analyses gamers' habits from their online gaming profile and offers courses in valuable skills that reflect their aptitudes. These are skills that can be developed, and if carefully reworded, can be added to CVs.

Employers might still need convincing that gamers are not just teenagers wasting their time in their bedrooms without thinking about their career prospects. But business consultant Mia Bennett told the BBC that gaming can help skills like "decision-making, the ability to anticipate and scenario planning… It also helps with meta-skills - learning how to learn, experimentation, and creative thinking."

You might think that the idea of gaming developing transferable skills is like the games themselves – pure fantasy – and a gamer doesn’t want to associate the fun and escapism it provides with work. It certainly doesn’t guarantee you a good job, and you need to be an accomplished gamer for your skills to shine. But if so much time is being spent gripped by the challenge of Portal or the strategy of Civilization, why not put those talents to good use?

vocabulary.entry: thrilling /ˈθrɪlɪŋ/ adj. 令人兴奋的；刺激的
vocabulary.example: It was a thrilling experience to see the瀑布 up close.
vocabulary.translation: 近距离观赏瀑布是一次令人兴奋的体验。

vocabulary.entry: compete against /kəmˈpiːt əˈɡenst/ 与……竞争
vocabulary.example: She will compete against the best players in the world next month.
vocabulary.translation: 下个月她将与世界上最优秀的选手竞争。

vocabulary.entry: switch off /swɪtʃ ɒf/ 停止思考；摆脱（压力）
vocabulary.example: I need to switch off after a long day at work.
vocabulary.translation: 工作了一整天，我需要放松一下，不去想工作的事。

vocabulary.entry: gaming talents /ˈɡeɪmɪŋ ˈtælənts/ 游戏天赋
vocabulary.example: His gaming talents were noticed by a professional esports team.
vocabulary.translation: 他的游戏天赋被一支职业电竞队看中了。

vocabulary.entry: put to use /pʊt tu juːz/ 利用；运用
vocabulary.example: She finally put her language skills to use in her new job.
vocabulary.translation: 她终于在新工作中运用到了自己的语言技能。

vocabulary.entry: wake up to /weɪk ʌp tu/ 意识到；认识到
vocabulary.example: The company is waking up to the importance of environmental protection.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司正逐渐意识到环境保护的重要性。

vocabulary.entry: keyhole surgery /ˈkiːhəʊl ˈsɜːdʒəri/ 微创手术
vocabulary.example: Keyhole surgery is less invasive and has a shorter recovery time.
vocabulary.translation: 微创手术创伤更小，恢复时间也更短。

vocabulary.entry: games console /ɡeɪmz ˈkɒnsəʊl/ 游戏手柄；游戏主机
vocabulary.example: He spent the evening playing games on his new games console.
vocabulary.translation: 他整个晚上都在玩他的新游戏手柄。

vocabulary.entry: hand-eye coordination /ˌhænd aɪ kəʊˌɔːdɪˈneɪʃn/ 手眼协调能力
vocabulary.example: Playing tennis requires good hand-eye coordination.
vocabulary.translation: 打网球需要良好的手眼协调能力。

vocabulary.entry: apply to /əˈplaɪ tu/ 应用于；适用于
vocabulary.example: The rules apply to all employees, regardless of their position.
vocabulary.translation: 这些规定适用于所有员工，无论其职位高低。

vocabulary.entry: strategy and resource management /ˈstrætədʒi ənd rɪˈsɔːs ˈmænɪdʒmənt/ 战略与资源管理
vocabulary.example: The course teaches students strategy and resource management in business.
vocabulary.translation: 这门课程向学生传授商业中的战略与资源管理知识。

vocabulary.entry: gaming profile /ˈɡeɪmɪŋ ˈprəʊfaɪl/ 游戏档案
vocabulary.example: The website uses your gaming profile to recommend suitable games.
vocabulary.translation: 该网站根据你的游戏档案推荐合适的游戏。

vocabulary.entry: aptitude /ˈæptɪtjuːd/ n. 天赋；天资
vocabulary.example: She has an aptitude for music and learns instruments quickly.
vocabulary.translation: 她有音乐天赋，学乐器很快。

vocabulary.entry: reword /ˌriːˈwɜːd/ v. 改写；重新措辞
vocabulary.example: Please reword this sentence to make it more formal.
vocabulary.translation: 请改写这个句子，使其更正式一些。

vocabulary.entry: CV (Curriculum Vitae) /ˌsiː ˈviː/ 个人简历；履历
vocabulary.example: I need to update my CV before applying for jobs.
vocabulary.translation: 申请工作前，我需要更新我的个人简历。

vocabulary.entry: career prospects /kəˈrɪə ˈprɒspekts/ 职业前景
vocabulary.example: This job offers excellent career prospects for young professionals.
vocabulary.translation: 这份工作为年轻专业人士提供了良好的职业前景。

vocabulary.entry: anticipate /ænˈtɪsɪpeɪt/ v. 预判；预期
vocabulary.example: The company failed to anticipate changes in the market.
vocabulary.translation: 该公司未能预判市场的变化。

vocabulary.entry: scenario planning /səˈnɑːriəʊ ˈplænɪŋ/ 场景规划；情景规划
vocabulary.example: Scenario planning helps businesses prepare for unexpected events.
vocabulary.translation: 场景规划帮助企业为突发事件做准备。

vocabulary.entry: meta-skills /ˈmetə skɪlz/ 元技能（指学习、思考等可迁移的基础技能）
vocabulary.example: Meta-skills like critical thinking are essential in any career.
vocabulary.translation: 批判性思维等元技能在任何职业中都至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: transferable skills /trænsˈfɜːrəbl skɪlz/ 可迁移技能（能应用于不同工作的技能）
vocabulary.example: Communication and teamwork are valuable transferable skills.
vocabulary.translation: 沟通和团队合作是宝贵的可迁移技能。

vocabulary.entry: escapism /ɪˈskeɪpɪzəm/ n. 逃避现实；解脱
vocabulary.example: For some people, reading is a form of escapism from daily stress.
vocabulary.translation: 对一些人来说，阅读是摆脱日常压力的一种逃避现实的方式。

vocabulary.entry: accomplished /əˈkʌmplɪʃt/ adj. 技艺精湛的；熟练的
vocabulary.example: She is an accomplished pianist who has performed worldwide.
vocabulary.translation: 她是一位技艺精湛的钢琴家，曾在全球各地演出。
